mapper.sql: r.id AS run_id, r.run_uuid, r.task_id, r.turn_id, t.user_id, COALESCE(r.agent_key, t.metadata ->> 'scenario') AS scenario, COALESCE(latest_snapshot.metadata ->> 'aiPurpose', latest_snapshot.metadata ->> 'purpose') AS purpose, COALESCE(latest_snapshot.metadata ->> 'aiSource', latest_snapshot.metadata ->> 'source') AS source, COALESCE(r.provider, latest_step.provider, latest_snapshot.provider) AS provider, COALESCE(r.model, latest_step.model, latest_snapshot.model) AS model, UPPER(r.status) AS status, r.finish_reason, COALESCE(step_counts.step_count, 0) AS step_count, COALESCE(step_counts.failed_step_count, 0) AS failed_step_count, COALESCE(tool_counts.tool_call_count, 0) AS tool_call_count, COALESCE(tool_counts.failed_tool_call_count, 0) AS failed_tool_call_count, COALESCE( NULLIF(latest_snapshot.token_budget, 0), agent_audit_nonnegative_bigint(latest_snapshot.metadata ->> 'promptTokenBudget')::INT ) AS prompt_token_budget, agent_audit_nonnegative_bigint(latest_snapshot.metadata ->> 'assemblyTokenEstimate')::INT AS assembly_token_estimate, COALESCE( agent_audit_nonnegative_bigint(latest_snapshot.metadata ->> 'finalRequestTokenEstimate')::INT, latest_snapshot.token_estimate ) AS final_request_token_estimate, COALESCE( agent_audit_nonnegative_bigint(latest_usage.usage ->> 'inputTokens'), agent_audit_nonnegative_bigint(r.usage ->> 'inputTokens') ) AS actual_input_tokens, COALESCE( agent_audit_nonnegative_bigint(latest_usage.usage ->> 'cachedTokens'), agent_audit_nonnegative_bigint(r.usage ->> 'cachedTokens') ) AS cached_tokens, CASE WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(latest_snapshot.token_budget, 0), agent_audit_nonnegative_bigint(latest_snapshot.metadata ->> 'promptTokenBudget')) IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE GREATEST( 0, COALESCE( agent_audit_nonnegative_bigint(latest_usage.usage ->> 'inputTokens'), agent_audit_nonnegative_bigint(r.usage ->> 'inputTokens'), agent_audit_nonnegative_bigint(latest_snapshot.metadata ->> 'finalRequestTokenEstimate'), latest_snapshot.token_estimate, 0 ) - COALESCE(NULLIF(latest_snapshot.token_budget, 0), agent_audit_nonnegative_bigint(latest_snapshot.metadata ->> 'promptTokenBudget')) ) END AS over_budget_tokens, COALESCE((latest_snapshot.metadata ->> 'compactionApplied') = 'true', FALSE) AS compaction_applied, COALESCE(jsonb_array_length( CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(latest_snapshot.metadata -> 'compactionActions') = 'array' THEN latest_snapshot.metadata -> 'compactionActions' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END ), 0) AS compaction_action_count, (r.status IN ('failed', 'cancelled') OR COALESCE(step_counts.failed_step_count, 0) > 0) AS provider_error, r.started_at, r.ended_at

FROM agent_run r JOIN agent_task t ON t.id = r.task_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COUNT(*)::INT AS step_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'failed')::INT AS failed_step_count FROM agent_run_step WHERE run_id = r.id ) step_counts ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COUNT(*)::INT AS tool_call_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'failed')::INT AS failed_tool_call_count FROM agent_tool_call WHERE run_id = r.id ) tool_counts ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT s.provider, s.model FROM agent_run_step s WHERE s.run_id = r.id ORDER BY s.step_index DESC LIMIT 1 ) latest_step ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT cs.* FROM agent_context_snapshot cs WHERE cs.run_id = r.id AND r.diagnostic_redacted_at IS NULL AND (r.diagnostic_retention_expires_at IS NULL OR r.diagnostic_retention_expires_at > NOW()) ORDER BY cs.step_index DESC, cs.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) latest_snapshot ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT s.usage FROM agent_run_step s WHERE s.run_id = r.id AND s.usage <> '{}'::jsonb ORDER BY s.step_index DESC LIMIT 1 ) latest_usage ON TRUE

where.if: AND (COALESCE(NULLIF(latest_snapshot.token_budget, 0), agent_audit_nonnegative_bigint(latest_snapshot.metadata ->> 'promptTokenBudget')) IS NULL OR COALESCE( agent_audit_nonnegative_bigint(latest_usage.usage ->> 'inputTokens'), agent_audit_nonnegative_bigint(r.usage ->> 'inputTokens'), agent_audit_nonnegative_bigint(latest_snapshot.metadata ->> 'finalRequestTokenEstimate'), latest_snapshot.token_estimate, 0 ) <= COALESCE(NULLIF(latest_snapshot.token_budget, 0), agent_audit_nonnegative_bigint(latest_snapshot.metadata ->> 'promptTokenBudget')))
AND r.status NOT IN ('failed', 'cancelled') AND COALESCE(step_counts.failed_step_count, 0) = 0

mapper.sql: COALESCE(NULLIF(latest_snapshot.token_budget, 0), agent_audit_nonnegative_bigint(latest_snapshot.metadata ->> 'promptTokenBudget')) AS prompt_token_budget, COALESCE( agent_audit_nonnegative_bigint(latest_usage.usage ->> 'inputTokens'), agent_audit_nonnegative_bigint(r.usage ->> 'inputTokens'), agent_audit_nonnegative_bigint(latest_snapshot.metadata ->> 'finalRequestTokenEstimate'), latest_snapshot.token_estimate ) AS audited_input_tokens, COALESCE( agent_audit_nonnegative_bigint(latest_usage.usage ->> 'inputTokens'), agent_audit_nonnegative_bigint(r.usage ->> 'inputTokens') ) AS reported_input_tokens, COALESCE( agent_audit_nonnegative_bigint(latest_usage.usage ->> 'cachedTokens'), agent_audit_nonnegative_bigint(r.usage ->> 'cachedTokens') ) AS audited_cached_tokens, COALESCE((latest_snapshot.metadata ->> 'compactionApplied') = 'true', FALSE) AS compaction_applied

choose.when: ORDER BY CASE WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(latest_snapshot.token_budget, 0), agent_audit_nonnegative_bigint(latest_snapshot.metadata ->> 'promptTokenBudget')) > 0 THEN GREATEST(0, COALESCE( agent_audit_nonnegative_bigint(latest_usage.usage ->> 'inputTokens'), agent_audit_nonnegative_bigint(r.usage ->> 'inputTokens'), agent_audit_nonnegative_bigint(latest_snapshot.metadata ->> 'finalRequestTokenEstimate'), latest_snapshot.token_estimate, 0 ) - COALESCE(NULLIF(latest_snapshot.token_budget, 0), agent_audit_nonnegative_bigint(latest_snapshot.metadata ->> 'promptTokenBudget'))) ELSE 0 END ASCDESC, r.started_at DESC, r.id DESC

ORDER BY CASE WHEN COALESCE(agent_audit_nonnegative_bigint(latest_usage.usage ->> 'inputTokens'), agent_audit_nonnegative_bigint(r.usage ->> 'inputTokens')) > 0 AND COALESCE(agent_audit_nonnegative_bigint(latest_usage.usage ->> 'cachedTokens'), agent_audit_nonnegative_bigint(r.usage ->> 'cachedTokens')) IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(agent_audit_nonnegative_bigint(latest_usage.usage ->> 'cachedTokens'), agent_audit_nonnegative_bigint(r.usage ->> 'cachedTokens'))::NUMERIC / COALESCE(agent_audit_nonnegative_bigint(latest_usage.usage ->> 'inputTokens'), agent_audit_nonnegative_bigint(r.usage ->> 'inputTokens')) ELSE NULL END ASC NULLS LASTDESC NULLS LAST, r.started_at DESC, r.id DESC
choose.otherwise: ORDER BY r.started_at ASCDESC, r.id ASCDESC

mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS run_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE metrics.prompt_token_budget > 0 AND COALESCE(metrics.audited_input_tokens, 0) > metrics.prompt_token_budget) AS over_budget_run_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE metrics.compaction_applied) AS compaction_run_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE metrics.reported_input_tokens IS NOT NULL) AS usage_reported_run_count, SUM(metrics.reported_input_tokens) AS input_tokens, SUM(metrics.audited_cached_tokens) AS cached_tokens FROM ( SELECT r.id,
) metrics

SELECT , r.attempt_no, r.retry_of_run_id, r.max_steps, CASE WHEN r.diagnostic_redacted_at IS NULL AND (r.diagnostic_retention_expires_at IS NULL OR r.diagnostic_retention_expires_at > NOW()) THEN r.error ELSE NULL END AS error, r.diagnostic_retention_expires_at, r.diagnostic_redacted_at
WHERE r.id = #{runId}

SELECT t.id AS turn_id, t.sequence_no, t.status, MAX(CASE WHEN r.diagnostic_redacted_at IS NULL AND (r.diagnostic_retention_expires_at IS NULL OR r.diagnostic_retention_expires_at > NOW()) THEN LEFT(u.content, 4000) ELSE NULL END) AS user_message, u.created_at AS user_message_at, MAX(CASE WHEN r.diagnostic_redacted_at IS NULL AND (r.diagnostic_retention_expires_at IS NULL OR r.diagnostic_retention_expires_at > NOW()) THEN LEFT(a.content, 4000) ELSE NULL END) AS assistant_message, a.created_at AS assistant_message_at, COUNT(r.id)::INT AS run_attempt_count, COALESCE( jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object( 'runId', r.id, 'attemptNo', r.attempt_no, 'status', UPPER(r.status) ) ORDER BY r.attempt_no ASC, r.id ASC) FILTER (WHERE r.id IS NOT NULL), '[]'::jsonb ) AS run_attempts, BOOL_OR(EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM agent_tool_call tc WHERE tc.run_id = r.id)) AS has_tools, SUM(agent_audit_nonnegative_bigint(r.usage ->> 'inputTokens')) AS input_tokens, SUM(agent_audit_nonnegative_bigint(r.usage ->> 'cachedTokens')) AS cached_tokens, SUM(agent_audit_nonnegative_bigint(r.usage ->> 'outputTokens')) AS output_tokens, SUM(agent_audit_nonnegative_bigint(r.usage ->> 'reasoningTokens')) AS reasoning_tokens, SUM(agent_audit_nonnegative_bigint(r.usage ->> 'totalTokens')) AS total_tokens, MAX(CASE WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(cs.token_budget, 0), agent_audit_nonnegative_bigint(cs.metadata ->> 'promptTokenBudget')) > 0 THEN GREATEST(0, COALESCE(agent_audit_nonnegative_bigint(r.usage ->> 'inputTokens'), agent_audit_nonnegative_bigint(cs.metadata ->> 'finalRequestTokenEstimate'), cs.token_estimate, 0) - COALESCE( NULLIF(cs.token_budget, 0), agent_audit_nonnegative_bigint(cs.metadata ->> 'promptTokenBudget'))) ELSE 0 END) AS over_budget_tokens FROM agent_turn t LEFT JOIN agent_message u ON u.id = t.user_message_id AND u.status = 'active' LEFT JOIN agent_message a ON a.id = t.assistant_message_id AND a.status = 'active' LEFT JOIN agent_run r ON r.turn_id = t.id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT * FROM agent_context_snapshot snapshot WHERE snapshot.run_id = r.id AND r.diagnostic_redacted_at IS NULL AND (r.diagnostic_retention_expires_at IS NULL OR r.diagnostic_retention_expires_at > NOW()) ORDER BY snapshot.step_index DESC LIMIT 1 ) cs ON TRUE WHERE t.task_id = #{taskId} GROUP BY t.id, u.id, a.id ORDER BY t.sequence_no ASC

SELECT s.step_index, UPPER(s.status) AS status, s.provider, s.model, s.finish_reason, s.started_at, s.ended_at, s.usage, CASE WHEN r.diagnostic_redacted_at IS NULL AND (r.diagnostic_retention_expires_at IS NULL OR r.diagnostic_retention_expires_at > NOW()) THEN s.error ELSE NULL END AS error, cs.id AS snapshot_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(cs.token_budget, 0), agent_audit_nonnegative_bigint(cs.metadata ->> 'promptTokenBudget')::INT) AS prompt_token_budget, CASE WHEN cs.id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('role', message.value ->> 'role')) FROM jsonb_array_elements(cs.messages_json) AS message(value) ), '[]'::jsonb) END AS messages, NULL::JSONB AS tools, NULL::JSONB AS tool_choice, NULL::JSONB AS generation_options, NULL::JSONB AS request_snapshot, cs.request_hash, cs.redaction_policy_version, cs.retention_expires_at AS snapshot_retention_expires_at, cs.metadata AS snapshot_metadata, s.metadata AS step_metadata, COALESCE(tool_counts.tool_call_count, 0) AS tool_call_count, COALESCE(tool_counts.failed_tool_call_count, 0) AS failed_tool_call_count FROM agent_run_step s JOIN agent_run r ON r.id = s.run_id LEFT JOIN agent_context_snapshot cs ON cs.id = s.request_snapshot_id AND r.diagnostic_redacted_at IS NULL AND (r.diagnostic_retention_expires_at IS NULL OR r.diagnostic_retention_expires_at > NOW()) LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COUNT(*)::INT AS tool_call_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'failed')::INT AS failed_tool_call_count FROM agent_tool_call tc WHERE tc.run_id = s.run_id AND tc.step_index = s.step_index ) tool_counts ON TRUE WHERE s.run_id = #{runId} ORDER BY s.step_index ASC

SELECT s.step_index, UPPER(s.status) AS status, s.provider, s.model, s.finish_reason, s.started_at, s.ended_at, s.usage, CASE WHEN r.diagnostic_redacted_at IS NULL AND (r.diagnostic_retention_expires_at IS NULL OR r.diagnostic_retention_expires_at > NOW()) THEN s.error ELSE NULL END AS error, cs.id AS snapshot_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(cs.token_budget, 0), agent_audit_nonnegative_bigint(cs.metadata ->> 'promptTokenBudget')::INT) AS prompt_token_budget, cs.messages_json AS messages, cs.tools_json AS tools, cs.tool_choice_json AS tool_choice, cs.generation_options,
cs.request_snapshot_json NULL AS request_snapshot, cs.request_hash, cs.redaction_policy_version, cs.retention_expires_at AS snapshot_retention_expires_at, cs.metadata AS snapshot_metadata, s.metadata AS step_metadata, COALESCE(tool_counts.tool_call_count, 0) AS tool_call_count, COALESCE(tool_counts.failed_tool_call_count, 0) AS failed_tool_call_count FROM agent_run_step s JOIN agent_run r ON r.id = s.run_id LEFT JOIN agent_context_snapshot cs ON cs.id = s.request_snapshot_id AND r.diagnostic_redacted_at IS NULL AND (r.diagnostic_retention_expires_at IS NULL OR r.diagnostic_retention_expires_at > NOW()) LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COUNT(*)::INT AS tool_call_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'failed')::INT AS failed_tool_call_count FROM agent_tool_call tc WHERE tc.run_id = s.run_id AND tc.step_index = s.step_index ) tool_counts ON TRUE WHERE s.run_id = #{runId} AND s.step_index = #{stepIndex}

SELECT tc.tool_call_id, tc.tool_name, UPPER(tc.status) AS status, CASE WHEN r.diagnostic_redacted_at IS NULL AND (r.diagnostic_retention_expires_at IS NULL OR r.diagnostic_retention_expires_at > NOW()) THEN tc.arguments_json ELSE NULL END AS arguments, CASE WHEN r.diagnostic_redacted_at IS NULL AND (r.diagnostic_retention_expires_at IS NULL OR r.diagnostic_retention_expires_at > NOW()) THEN tc.result_json ELSE NULL END AS result, CASE WHEN r.diagnostic_redacted_at IS NULL AND (r.diagnostic_retention_expires_at IS NULL OR r.diagnostic_retention_expires_at > NOW()) THEN tc.result_preview_json ELSE NULL END AS preview, tc.result_storage_mode, CASE WHEN r.diagnostic_redacted_at IS NULL AND (r.diagnostic_retention_expires_at IS NULL OR r.diagnostic_retention_expires_at > NOW()) THEN tc.result_blob_id ELSE NULL END AS result_blob_id, CASE WHEN r.diagnostic_redacted_at IS NULL AND (r.diagnostic_retention_expires_at IS NULL OR r.diagnostic_retention_expires_at > NOW()) THEN tc.result_ref ELSE NULL END AS result_ref, tc.result_sha256, tc.argument_char_count, tc.argument_token_estimate, tc.result_char_count, tc.result_token_estimate, tc.result_line_count, tc.duration_millis, CASE WHEN r.diagnostic_redacted_at IS NULL AND (r.diagnostic_retention_expires_at IS NULL OR r.diagnostic_retention_expires_at > NOW()) THEN tc.error ELSE NULL END AS error, tc.redaction_policy_version, tc.started_at, tc.ended_at FROM agent_tool_call tc JOIN agent_run r ON r.id = tc.run_id WHERE tc.run_id = #{runId} AND tc.step_index = #{stepIndex} ORDER BY tc.started_at ASC, tc.id ASC

SELECT tc.run_id, tc.step_index, tc.tool_call_id, tc.tool_name, UPPER(tc.status) AS status, tc.result_storage_mode, CASE WHEN r.diagnostic_redacted_at IS NULL AND (r.diagnostic_retention_expires_at IS NULL OR r.diagnostic_retention_expires_at > NOW()) THEN tc.result_ref ELSE NULL END AS result_ref, COALESCE(tc.result_sha256, blob.sha256) AS result_sha256, COALESCE(tc.result_char_count, blob.char_count) AS result_char_count, COALESCE(tc.result_line_count, blob.line_count) AS result_line_count, CASE WHEN r.diagnostic_redacted_at IS NULL AND (r.diagnostic_retention_expires_at IS NULL OR r.diagnostic_retention_expires_at > NOW()) THEN tc.result_json ELSE NULL END AS result, CASE WHEN r.diagnostic_redacted_at IS NULL AND (r.diagnostic_retention_expires_at IS NULL OR r.diagnostic_retention_expires_at > NOW()) THEN tc.result_preview_json ELSE NULL END AS preview,
CASE WHEN r.diagnostic_redacted_at IS NULL AND (r.diagnostic_retention_expires_at IS NULL OR r.diagnostic_retention_expires_at > NOW()) THEN SUBSTRING(COALESCE(blob.content_text, '') FROM #{offset} + 1 FOR #{limit}) ELSE NULL END
NULL AS content, CASE WHEN blob.id IS NOT NULL AND r.diagnostic_redacted_at IS NULL AND (r.diagnostic_retention_expires_at IS NULL OR r.diagnostic_retention_expires_at > NOW()) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS content_available, r.diagnostic_retention_expires_at, r.diagnostic_redacted_at FROM agent_tool_call tc JOIN agent_run r ON r.id = tc.run_id LEFT JOIN agent_content_blob blob ON blob.id = tc.result_blob_id WHERE tc.run_id = #{runId} AND tc.tool_call_id = #{toolCallId} ORDER BY tc.step_index DESC LIMIT 1
